scope: One real application task using a bounded drafting worker, independent content/PDF review and a supervising controller for external actions.

worker.tools: Native file tools and the existing JSON validator; no worker shell or browser.
worker.qualification: Prior validator and renderer qualification reused; no new operating-system sandbox qualification.

acceptance.syntax_limit: Validator receipts bind final JSON bytes; factual support, schema, style and layout require separate review.

documentation.finding: Independent review found an orphan attachment-section heading.

external_task.basis: Root controller reports actual portal confirmation, matching email and tracker readback; local evidence records retain those observations.
external_task.limit: One recorded click is not a distributed exactly-once guarantee. Local hashes and visible filenames do not prove the server retained identical bytes. Hiring outcome and user-confirmed resolution are unknown.

controller_observations.observation: Export returned exit code zero with empty stdout and no PDF; both attempts were classified as failed and retained.
Offline export succeeded through the reviewed runtime permission route; this was a controller fix, not a worker repair or security-policy change.
Stale browser indices required controller refresh/correction; frequency and broader cause remain unmeasured.
Login required intervention; this was not unattended end-to-end execution.
Explicit UTF-8 corrected an initial reviewer comparison. A single extraction line wrap received narrow independent adjudication with original checks retained.
A later independent review rejected an orphan heading. A local layout-only reflow then passed independent content and visual review on all five pages; the failed review remains preserved.

six_investor_questions.question: What exact claim are you testing?
six_investor_questions.answer: Operational observation: the existing bounded worker produced two final JSON artifacts with actual syntax/hash validation and independent content/letter-PDF acceptance in one build; the assisted controller then completed the external task.
six_investor_questions.metric: One build, zero worker repairs, two final-output validator receipts; independent content and letter-PDF pass; portal/email/tracker confirmation; checked completion stages and final documentation reflow acceptance.

six_investor_questions.question: Compared with what?
six_investor_questions.answer: No controlled comparator was run. P005 is a prior reuse reference and P007 supplies local validation context; different tasks and controller work make their outcomes unsuitable for a causal cost/quality comparison.

six_investor_questions.question: What result would make you stop?
six_investor_questions.answer: The pre-dispatch task contract allowed one soft USD2/600-second build and at most one soft USD1/300-second repair, with all attempts retained. Missing final validator receipts or failed content/layout criteria prevent artifact acceptance; a failed final artifact stops after the repair. External confirmation must be observed, not inferred. A failed documentation visual review prevents marking that document accepted. These are operational acceptance conditions, not a preregistered performance study.

six_investor_questions.question: Where did your approach lose?
six_investor_questions.answer: Two exports appeared successful by exit code yet produced no PDF, stale browser indices needed correction, and login required intervention. Reviewer decoding/extraction handling needed correction; final documentation had an orphan heading. Two nonblocking note interpretations also required qualification. Zero worker repairs does not mean zero task corrections.

six_investor_questions.question: What did this really cost?
six_investor_questions.answer: Native worker usage was USD1.2040785, 271938 reported tokens and 229.016 seconds. This includes cache-read and cache-creation token categories. Controller/reviewer usage, failed export work, preparation, evaluation and human time are unknown; total task/research cost is unknown. Prior qualification is not charged again.

six_investor_questions.question: What decision does the next expenditure enable?
six_investor_questions.answer: First use inexpensive local checks to decide whether export receipt/PDF assertions, heading pagination and fresh browser-target resolution cover the observed failures. Another paid comparison is useful only after defining a competent alternative and collecting fuller costs; this record neither proves gains nor authorizes it.

accounting.native_usage_basis: List-price usage reported by native result; not a verified invoice or full research cost.

remaining_limits: No controlled gain in quality, cost, speed or orchestration capability is established.
Native completion, content acceptance, document layout and external outcome are separate observations.
Direct controller browser calls remain outside an exclusive guarded executor; no exactly-once or general recovery guarantee follows.
Public aggregates and prior references do not reproduce the private task, inputs or acceptance evidence.
Scoped task acceptance is complete; public publication remains a separate permission decision.
